## Loading Datasets

First load the USDA NASS data from Parquet Files

```{r load_fao}
#| echo: true
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
# Load the full fao dataset
read_parquet(
  file.path(data_path,"USDA-NASS","parquet","crops_county.parquet")
) -> nass_crops
```

## About the USDA NASS

The US Department of Agriculture's [National Agricultural Statistics](https://www.nass.usda.gov/)

- Timely, accurate, and objective operational data
- US domestic agricultural production.
- Survey random sample of farms every year
- Expanded [quinquennial](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/quinquennial) Census of Agriculture
  - Intended to be consistent and comparable for every US county


## Goals of NASS

- Report the facts on American agriculture
- Objective and unbiased statistics on a preannounced schedule
  - Fair and impartial to all market participants
- Safeguard the privacy of farmers, ranchers, and other data providers


## Collected Data

**Crops**

- Acreage: Acres planted, acres intended for planting, and acres harvested.
- Yield & Production: Average yield per acre and total aggregate volume harvested
- Commodities Tracked: 
  - Field crops (corn, soybeans, wheat, cotton)
  - Fruit and tree nuts
  - Vegetables
  - Floriculture/horticulture.


## Collected Data

**Livestock**

- Inventories: Head counts of 
  - Cattle, hogs, sheep, goats, and poultry 
  - Distinct lifecycle stages
- Output Products: 
  - Dairy: Milk production per cow, total monthly production
  - Eggs: Egg sets and broiler chick placements
  - Other: Wool/mohair production
  - Meat & Processing: head counts and dressed average weights

## Understainding data

What years are covered?

```{r show-years}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
nass_crops |>
  count(YEAR) |> 
  arrange(YEAR) |> 
  print(n=Inf)
```

## Is time coverage even?

```{r historgram-years}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
ggplot(nass_crops) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(x=YEAR),
    binwidth=1,
    color="black",fill="blue"
    ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x="Year",
    y="Observation Count"
  )
```

## What Products are covered?

```{r show-all-proudcts}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
nass_crops |>
  distinct(SHORT_DESC) 
```


## What Corn Products are covered?

```{r show-corn-proudcts}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
nass_crops |>
  filter(str_detect(SHORT_DESC,"CORN")) |>
  distinct(SHORT_DESC) |>
  print(n=Inf)
```


## How have corn yields changed over time?

```{r graph-corn-yields}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
nass_crops |>
  filter(SHORT_DESC == "CORN, GRAIN - YIELD, MEASURED IN BU / ACRE") |>
  summarize(
    yield = mean(as.numeric(VALUE),na.rm=TRUE),
    .by=YEAR
  ) -> corn_yield

ggplot(corn_yield, aes(x=YEAR,y=yield)) +
  geom_line(color="black") +
  geom_smooth(se=FALSE,color="blue",alpha=.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x="Year",
    y="Corn Yield (bu/acre)"
  )
```
